meta.name: Paul Shervin
meta.tagline: Deep Learning, Generative & Agentic AI enthusiast

about: I'm an AI & ML student at Saveetha Engineering College specializing in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Agentic AI. I build intelligent solutions and have competed in national hackathons like the Smart India Hackathon. I love exploring new technologies and constantly push myself to innovate and solve real-world problems.

details: Core: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Structures
Active in coding clubs and AI research groups

projects.title: Smart Traffic Signal Optimization
projects.summary: RL-based adaptive traffic control system reducing congestion by 35%
projects.description: Developed an intelligent traffic management system using Deep Q-Networks (DQN) to dynamically adjust signal timings based on real-time traffic flow. The system reduces average waiting time and improves throughput in urban intersections.
projects.approach: Implemented custom Gym environment simulating multi-intersection traffic, trained DQN agent with prioritized experience replay, and deployed model for real-time inference.
projects.metrics: 35% reduction in average wait time, 28% improvement in traffic flow

projects.title: Document Summarizer
projects.summary: Transformer-based abstractive summarization with prompt tuning
projects.description: Built an advanced document summarization tool using fine-tuned BART model with custom prompt engineering for domain-specific summarization. Supports multi-document summarization and key insight extraction.
projects.approach: Fine-tuned BART on domain-specific corpus, implemented prompt templates for different document types, integrated with LangChain for document processing pipeline.

projects.title: Medical Image Segmentation
projects.summary: U-Net architecture for precise tumor detection in CT scans
projects.description: Developed a deep learning pipeline for automated tumor segmentation in medical CT scans. The U-Net model achieves high precision in identifying tumor boundaries, assisting radiologists in diagnosis.
projects.approach: Implemented custom U-Net with attention mechanisms, data augmentation pipeline for medical images, and post-processing for smooth segmentation masks.

projects.title: Agentic Workflow Orchestrator
projects.summary: Autonomous AI agent with tool-calling and multi-step reasoning
projects.description: Created an autonomous agent system that can break down complex tasks, use multiple tools (web search, calculators, APIs), and execute multi-step workflows with self-correction capabilities.
projects.approach: Designed agentic architecture using LangGraph for state management, implemented ReAct pattern for reasoning + acting, integrated multiple tool APIs with function calling.
projects.metrics: Successfully completes 78% of complex multi-step tasks

projects.title: Finamte
projects.summary: AI-powered personal finance assistant that provides smart budgeting, spending insights, and investment guidance.
projects.description: FinMate is an AI-powered personal finance assistant that provides smart budgeting, spending insights, and investment guidance, helping users manage their money effortlessly with contextual coaching and real-time insights.
projects.approach: Built using React and Firebase for data storage. Integrates generative AI models for personalized financial coaching, and handles UPI sync and OCR for auto-reading bill receipts.
projects.metrics: Saves average user 15% monthly, 95% budget accuracy
